Amazon.Com (AMZN) Position Has Boosted by Markel Corp; Public Employees Retirement Association Of Colorado Holds Holding in Jpmorgan Chase (JPM)
June 27, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Tom Gayner increased its stake in Amazon.Com (AMZN) by 5.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Markel Corp bought 4,720 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.80% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Tom Gayner held 84,720 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $122.62 million, up from 80,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Markel Corp who had been investing in Amazon.Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $820.56B market cap company. The stock increased 1.68% or $27.94 during the last trading session, reaching $1691.09. About 4.03M shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 62.09% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.52% the S&P500.
